page.overview:
Who is Eidolon?

Eidolons are summons in Final Fantasy Dimensions. They can be summoned by Summoners and by characters equipped with "Summon LV" ability.

{|class="full-width FFD article-table" style="text-align:center"

!width=15%|Eidolon !width=10%|Level !width=25%|Ability !width=10%|MP Cost !width=40%|Acquire

The Moogle Dance may result in summoning a group of moogles even though there is not a moogle Eidolon available in the game.
